# ADR-3013: A02: TLS minimum version setting for listener 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Legacy TLS enables downgrade and weak ciphers.

## Decision

Edge configuration MUST declare a TLS minimum version setting for listener 1 (A02-1).

## Consequences

Handshake metrics alert on protocol regressions.
